lines.text: Awesome job cowbell guy. You got a Patreon I could subscribe to or something?
I’m afraid I… don’t know how all that works.
Head to extraction Forty. I’ve hacked ads into LeBooBoo’s premium feed. I think that’s the last we’ll be hearing from him...
Hey cowbell, let me set you up on Patreon - wait what, there's an Ad in my premium feed! What do they think this is Disney Plus!?
Forty! Take the exit back stage. Go now.
